title: GEMglBegin
description: delimit the vertices of a primitive or a group of like primitives

messages.description: primitive to build from the vertices, e.g. GL_LINES or GL_TRIANGLES

arguments.description: primitive to build from the vertices, e.g. GL_LINES or GL_TRIANGLES

body: [GEMglBegin] calls glBegin() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glBegin in the OpenGL reference.
